start.speaker: Mira
start.text: You put it down and then you went down with it. Both of those happened. Only one of them will be written anywhere.

r2.speaker: Mira
r2.text: Four floors and the fourth one had you. I have watched that number climb for years and it climbs the same way for everyone.

r3.speaker: Mira
r3.text: Down and back up entire. Do not make a habit of the feeling. Make a habit of the coming back up.

r4.speaker: Mira
r4.text: The Hollow. People walk toward a light there that has not been in front of them for eleven years. Do not join the walk.

r5.speaker: Mira
r5.text: I have stopped saying be careful. You are careful. It is not a careful problem.

quiet.speaker: Mira
quiet.text: The way down is open. It is always open. That is not the kindness people take it for.
